item.title: Track an audio tour through two rooms
item.summary: A museum guide helps visitors match objects to two craft processes.
item.transcript_text: Our first room is about getting colour into cloth. Stop at the table with the three glass jars. The jar in the middle holds onion skins. Workers saved the outer layers because they made a strong yellow colour. The cloth hanging beside the table is a modern sample, so please feel how stiff it is. In the next room, follow the dotted floor line to the large wooden frame. That frame holds the cloth flat while a worker stitches a border. The cloth there came from a workshop that closed in the nineteen fifties. You can look closely, but please do not touch it.

questions.prompt: What is the guide mainly doing?
options: Explaining how all rooms were built

Directing visitors through two steps of a craft
questions.explanation: The first room concerns colouring cloth and the next shows stitching.

questions.prompt: Which jar is connected with yellow dye?
options: The jar in the next room
questions.explanation: The middle jar contains the onion skins that produced yellow.

options: Any cloth on the wooden frame

questions.explanation: Visitors follow the line to the frame in the next room.

questions.prompt: Why is cloth stretched across the frame?
options: To compare the colour to the jars
To carry it to the shop
